list.title: Your Research
list.lede: A Research starts from a question about your customers and collects the feedback you need to answer it.

firstRun.title: Here you keep your questions about customers, with their answers.
firstRun.lede: Start from a question you want answered before a decision. Then collect feedback: a form with a QR code, interview notes, a CSV.

form.label: Your question
form.hint: For example: why don't small teams move to Pro after the trial?

errors.empty: Write the question you want to answer. For example: why don't small teams move to Pro after the trial?
errors.tooLong: The question is over 200 characters: keep it to a single question.
errors.failed: I couldn't save the Research. Try again shortly: your question is still here.
errors.session: Your session has expired. Log in again to continue: copy the text you wrote first, it won't stay here.

header.ledeCount: {count} feedback from {channels, plural, one {1 channel} other {# channels}}, {start} to {end}.
header.ledeEmpty: No feedback yet. The form is on.

notFound.title: I can't find this Research.
notFound.text: It may have been deleted, or the link belongs to another account.

notes.title: Paste the notes of an interview
notes.lede: One interview at a time: one person's notes are one feedback. A message copied from an email or Slack works too: change the channel.
notes.textPlaceholder: The person's words, as you wrote them down
notes.emptyHint: Notes are not saved until you add them.
notes.added: Added to this Research. You'll find them in Feedback.

errors.empty: Paste the notes before adding them.
errors.tooLong: The notes are over 10,000 characters. Keep the parts that report what the person said.
errors.limit: You've reached 100 feedback, the Free plan limit across all your Research: these notes weren't saved.
errors.futureDate: Pick today or a date in the past.
errors.channel: Say where it comes from, at most {limit} characters.
errors.session: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue: copy the text you wrote first, it won't stay here.

synthesis.lede: {count} feedback from {start} to {end}, grouped into {themes} themes.

analyze.label: Analyze {count} feedback
analyze.labelThemesOnly: Analyze only the themes of {count} feedback
analyze.runningNote: It can take a few minutes. Themes and verdicts show up here as soon as it's done.
analyze.slowNote: This is taking longer than usual. Themes and verdicts will show up here: you can leave the page and come back.
analyze.announcement: Analysis done: {count, plural, one {1 theme} other {# themes}}.
analyze.network: I can't reach Voce. If the analysis had already started, the result shows up here when it's done: reload the page in a few minutes.
analyze.lowFeedbackNote: With fewer than 5 feedback the themes say little: you can analyze them anyway.

cost.one: You'll use 1 of your {limit} analyses for {month}.
cost.two: You'll use 2 of your {limit} analyses for {month}: one for the themes, one for the hypothesis verdict.

analyze.themesFailed: The themes were not updated and don't count toward this month's limit: the ones from {date} stay. The hypothesis verdict is ready below.
analyze.themesFailedFirst: The themes didn't come through and don't count toward this month's limit. The hypothesis verdict is ready below.
analyze.verdictFailed: The verdict didn't come through and doesn't count toward this month's limit: the hypotheses still show the previous verdict. Try again with “Verdict only”.
analyze.verdictFailedNextAnalysis: The verdict didn't come through and doesn't count toward this month's limit: the hypotheses still show the previous verdict. It comes with the next analysis.
analyze.themesOnlyNote: You have 1 analysis left for {month}: enough for the themes, not for the verdict, which uses another one. The hypothesis verdict is available again on {nextMonth} 1, or right away with Pro.
analyze.upToDate: No new feedback after the analysis of {date}.

changes.line: Since the analysis of {date}: {feedback, plural, one {1 more feedback} other {# more feedback}}, {themes, plural, one {1 new theme} other {# new themes}}.

newSince.title: {count, plural, one {1 new feedback to analyze} other {# new feedback to analyze}}
newSince.text: Arrived after the analysis of {date}: the themes and verdicts below don't count them yet.

hypotheses.title: Hypotheses
hypotheses.emptyText: Have an idea to put to the test? Write it as a hypothesis: the feedback will tell whether they confirm it.
hypotheses.label: New hypothesis
hypotheses.hint: One claim per hypothesis, one that can be confirmed or refuted.
hypotheses.twoClaims: This looks like two claims: the verdict is clearer if you write them as two hypotheses.
hypotheses.added: Hypothesis added. The verdict comes with the next analysis.
hypotheses.noVerdict: No verdict yet. It comes with the next analysis.
hypotheses.maxReached: This Research already has 5 hypotheses, the maximum. Delete one to write another.
hypotheses.editWarning: If you change the text, the current verdict is removed: it was about the previous sentence. The new one comes with the next analysis.
hypotheses.deleteConfirm: You are deleting the hypothesis and its verdict. This cannot be undone.

errors.empty: Write the hypothesis as a sentence the feedback can confirm or refute. For example: small teams do not move to Pro because the price is per user.
errors.tooLong: The hypothesis is over 200 characters: keep it to a single claim.
errors.failed: I couldn't save the hypothesis. Try again shortly: your text is still here.
errors.deleteFailed: I couldn't delete the hypothesis. Try again shortly.
errors.session: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue: copy the text you wrote first, it won't stay here.
errors.busy: An analysis of this Research is running: you can change the hypotheses once it's done.

verdictOnly.label: Verdict only for {count, plural, one {1 hypothesis} other {# hypotheses}}

verdict.noEvidence: None of the {read} feedback read mentions it.
verdict.writtenAfter: Written on {date}. Of the {read} feedback read, {count, plural, one {1 arrived after} other {# arrived after}}.
verdict.writtenBefore: Written on {date}. All {read} feedback read had already arrived when you wrote it: the verdict rereads them, it doesn't test it against new feedback.
verdict.arrivedAfterVerdict: {count, plural, one {1 feedback has arrived} other {# feedback have arrived}} since this verdict.
verdict.moreQuotes: Show {count, plural, one {one more quote} other {# more quotes}}

delete.confirm: You delete “{question}” with its {count} feedback, the themes, the hypotheses and the verdicts. The form link and the QR code stop working. This can't be undone.
delete.failed: I couldn't delete the Research. Nothing changed: try again in a moment.
delete.session: Your session has expired. Log in again to continue.
